method: Google Maps satellite visually inspected in root cloud browser
observations: Four distinct platform-like bodies are visible in two separated eastern/western groups.

The eastern island mapped OSM ref4;5 has two running tracks between it and the eastern side platform ref6. Its yard-side western edge adjoins broad bare earth in the inspected frame; no clearly laid immediately adjacent road was discernible.
Western island ref2;3 has a visible yard-side alignment near its eastern edge; mapped polygon/track registration appears imperfect.
A full-width footbridge links both groups.
The eastern marker is by the eastern side entry, not proof of the main western entrance location.
interpretation: Satellite observation does not resolve current six-face operational road arrangement. Do not add an unverified rail just to satisfy a count. Current IRI6 can coexist with older/undated imagery; preserve uncertainty and reconstruction choices.
